purpose: Correlate each action's wall-time tail with existing CPU phase and exact-matched final GPU submission timestamps. Not a speed comparison or acceptance run.
expected_exit_reason: diagnostic run completed: acceptance gates are intentionally disabled
required_before_execution: Strict relevant lint and focused tests
Ordinary release binary copied to new path and hashed
No concurrent source edits, compilation, tests, diagnostics or benchmarks
data_contract: All 1000 action indices preserved in order
Same captured elapsed value used by each raw record and wall summary
Missing, disabled, pending, stale, invalid and recovery observations explicit
No stage value fabricated or backfilled for an unmatched submission
CPU map phase includes render, copy, queue and mapping rather than pure GPU execution
Retry CPU phases span attempts; retained GPU sample is final submission only
New reporting is diagnostic overhead, never a claimed production speedup
Both bounds and partial-write request and actual-selection evidence checked
Current CPU-renderer timestamps cannot by themselves distinguish useful execution from all scheduling effects
analysis: Report complete/missing/mismatched/recovery counts with the full denominator
Compare per-action slow rows with same-row CPU/GPU stages; do not equate unrelated quantiles
Keep stage category mapping explicit and preserve exact submission ids
State any unmeasured wall residual without labelling it scheduling by subtraction alone
